mapper.sql: select e.*, (select count(*) from shop_zhenke_enjoy_like l where l.enjoy_id=e.enjoy_id) like_count, (select count(*) from shop_zhenke_enjoy_comment c where c.enjoy_id=e.enjoy_id and c.del_flag='0') comment_count, case when #{currentUserId} is not null and exists( select 1 from shop_zhenke_enjoy_like mine where mine.enjoy_id=e.enjoy_id and mine.shop_user_id=#{currentUserId} ) then true else false end liked_by_me from shop_zhenke_enjoy e
mapper.select: where e.enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and e.del_flag='0' and e.status='0'
mapper.insert: insert into shop_zhenke_enjoy(category,title,subtitle,cover_url,content,highlights,place_name,place_address,display_sort,status,del_flag,published_at,create_by,create_time,update_by,update_time) values(#{category},#{title},#{subtitle},#{coverUrl},#{content},#{highlights},#{placeName},#{placeAddress},#{displaySort},#{status},'0',case when #{status}='0' then sysdate() else null end,#{createBy},sysdate(),#{updateBy},sysdate())
mapper.update: update shop_zhenke_enjoy set category=#{category},title=#{title},subtitle=#{subtitle},cover_url=#{coverUrl},content=#{content},highlights=#{highlights},place_name=#{placeName},place_address=#{placeAddress},display_sort=#{displaySort},status=#{status},published_at=case when #{status}='0' then coalesce(published_at,sysdate()) else published_at end,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and del_flag='0'
update shop_zhenke_enjoy set del_flag='2',update_by=#{user},update_time=sysdate() where enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and del_flag='0'

update shop_zhenke_enjoy set status=#{status},published_at=case when #{status}='0' then coalesce(published_at,sysdate()) else published_at end,update_by=#{user},update_time=sysdate() where enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.insert: insert ignore into shop_zhenke_enjoy_like(enjoy_id,shop_user_id,create_time) select #{enjoyId},#{shopUserId},sysdate() from shop_zhenke_enjoy where enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and del_flag='0' and status='0'
mapper.delete: delete from shop_zhenke_enjoy_like where enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and shop_user_id=#{shopUserId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from shop_zhenke_enjoy_like where enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and shop_user_id=#{shopUserId}
mapper.sql: select c.*,u.user_name,u.nick_name,u.avatar,coalesce(ru.nick_name,ru.user_name) reply_to_name from shop_zhenke_enjoy_comment c join shop_zhenke_enjoy e on e.enjoy_id=c.enjoy_id and e.del_flag='0' join shop_user u on u.user_id=c.shop_user_id left join shop_zhenke_enjoy_comment rc on rc.comment_id=c.reply_to_comment_id left join shop_user ru on ru.user_id=rc.shop_user_id
mapper.select: where c.enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and c.del_flag='0' order by coalesce(c.parent_comment_id,c.comment_id),c.create_time,c.comment_id
where c.enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and c.comment_id=#{commentId} and c.del_flag='0'
mapper.update: update shop_zhenke_enjoy_comment set del_flag='2',delete_time=sysdate(),update_time=sysdate() where enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and comment_id=#{commentId} and shop_user_id=#{shopUserId} and del_flag='0'

update shop_zhenke_enjoy_comment set del_flag='2',delete_time=sysdate(),update_time=sysdate() where enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and del_flag='0' and (comment_id=#{commentId} or parent_comment_id=#{commentId}) and exists(select 1 from (select comment_id from shop_zhenke_enjoy_comment where enjoy_id=#{enjoyId} and comment_id=#{commentId} and shop_user_id=#{shopUserId} and parent_comment_id is null and del_flag='0') owned)
